entries.name: Equal-depth collision-product states
entries.definition: Number of reachable states in the row-synchronous product automaton comparing two rooted column paths of lengths a and b that end at the same frontier, with a bit tracking different penultimate frontiers. At a=b, exchange of the two paths is canonicalized.
entries.why: Measures exact state-space growth of the bounded-depth collision test.
checks: All 28 depth pairs 1<=a<=b<=7 completed as no_collision in the recorded exact product search.
Equal-depth path pairs are exchange-canonicalized; unequal-depth pairs are not.
These are product-automaton state counts, not numbers of tilings or collisions.

entries.why: Locates diagonal-only contact moves by offset radius.
checks: Literal relation classification; shell total matches the corresponding contact/overlap histogram.

entries.name: Maximum fe70 packing in a small square
entries.definition: Maximum number of pairwise disjoint whole free fe70 copies in n×n.
entries.why: Exact constructive packing capacity, not an arithmetic relaxation.
checks: CP-SAT OPTIMAL and matching bound; independent literal D4 whole-cell witness replay. Separate SciPy/HiGHS MILP confirms n=7..11. Non-OPTIMAL boards are not terms.

entries.name: E zero-displacement returns
entries.definition: Number of length-n paths from E phase L whose net horizontal displacement is zero; endpoint phase free.
entries.why: Necessary alignment count for an exceptional arm; not a completed tiling.
checks: Binary-path brute enumeration n<=6.

entries.name: E first zero-displacement returns
entries.definition: Number of length-n E paths from phase L whose displacement first returns to zero at step n, regardless of endpoint phase.
entries.why: Counts irreducible aligned exceptional walks, not geometrically capped arms.
checks: Binary-path brute enumeration n<=6.

entries.name: E coincident-endpoint ordered pairs
entries.definition: Ordered pairs of length-n E paths from L ending at the same (phase, horizontal displacement).
entries.why: Measures how many abstract arm histories can meet the same phase-aware port.
checks: Independent endpoint histogram from 2^n binary paths for n<=6.

entries.name: E opposed-displacement ordered pairs
entries.definition: Ordered pairs of length-n E paths from L with equal endpoint phase and opposite horizontal displacement.
entries.why: A necessary mirrored-arm endpoint match; no nonintersection or cap is imposed.
checks: Weighted endpoint DP; compare direct binary histograms n<=6.

entries.name: Balanced four-mode band words
entries.definition: Length-n words over literal P-band shifts {-3,-1,+1,+3} with total shift zero.
entries.why: Potential lateral realignment of a stacked P band, not a rectangle tiling.
checks: Direct 4^n word enumeration n<=6.

entries.name: First-return four-mode band words
entries.definition: Length-n P-band words whose running shift first returns to zero at final step n.
entries.why: Identifies irreducible zero-shift modules under concatenation.
checks: Direct 4^n prefix-sum enumeration n<=6.

entries.name: Nonnegative balanced band words
entries.definition: Zero-shift length-n P-band words with every partial shift nonnegative.
entries.why: Models one-sided drift constraints of a straight corridor; wall clearance is not certified.
checks: Direct 4^n prefix-sum enumeration n<=6.

entries.name: Nonnegative band meanders
entries.definition: Length-n P-band words with every partial shift nonnegative; final shift unrestricted.
entries.why: Counts all one-sided legal drift histories before endpoint alignment.
checks: Dynamic programming on nonnegative shifts; checked against brute n<=6.

entries.name: Three-cell-drift bounded band bridges
entries.definition: Zero-shift length-n P-band words with every partial shift in [-3,3].
entries.why: Measures abstract modules fitting a fixed lateral drift budget.
checks: Finite-state interval DP; checked against brute n<=6.

entries.name: Balanced band words using all four modes
entries.definition: Zero-shift length-n P-band words in which every shift -3,-1,+1,+3 occurs.
entries.why: Separates varied local pumps from repeated two-mode phases.
checks: Drift and used-mode-mask DP; checked against brute n<=6.

entries.name: Aperiodic balanced band words
entries.definition: Zero-shift length-n P-band words with least cyclic word period exactly n (no shorter repeated block).
entries.why: Removes repeated pump slabs before studying new periodic cores.
checks: Möbius inversion of PER05; direct word-period brute n<=6.

entries.name: Balanced band necklaces
entries.definition: Rotation orbits of zero-shift length-n P-band words, with no reflection quotient.
entries.why: Distinguishes periodic shift cycles without choosing a row origin.
checks: Burnside rotation fixed counts; canonical brute orbits n<=6.

entries.name: Balanced band signed bracelets
entries.definition: Orbits of zero-shift length-n P-band words under cyclic rotation and reversed, sign-negated order d_i -> -d_(n-1-i).
entries.why: Vertical reversal of a literal band negates and reverses its layer shifts.
checks: Burnside signed-reflection fixed pairs; canonical brute orbits n<=6.

entries.name: Whole-H open cylinders of circumference 10
entries.definition: Number of tilings of the labeled width-10, open-height-2n cylinder by the four horizontal fe70 orientations.
entries.why: Honest periodic-x tilings; their abundance does not imply a rectangle cap.
checks: All-H band theorem gives 20^n; independent direct cell-subset exact cover checks n=1,2.

entries.name: Whole-H 10-by-n torus tilings
entries.definition: Number of unordered whole-tile H-only tilings of the labeled 10-by-n torus, periodic in both axes, n>=3; translations are distinct.
entries.why: Counts honest vertical periodic bulk phases, including odd-height phases absent on open cylinders.
checks: Trace of 22-state weighted row-birth graph; independent wrapped exact cover n=3..6.

entries.name: Vertically primitive 10-by-n H tori
entries.definition: Number of PER15 labeled tilings whose row-birth history has least vertical period n; n>=3.
entries.why: Isolates genuinely new vertical periods rather than repeated smaller phases.
checks: Möbius inversion of exact graph-walk traces, including formal traces at n=1,2.

entries.name: 10-by-n H tori modulo vertical translation
entries.definition: Number of vertical-translation orbits of PER15 tilings; horizontal translations and reflections are not quotiented; n>=3.
entries.why: Measures distinct periodic bulk phases with arbitrary vertical origin removed.
checks: Burnside using exact graph-walk traces; wrapped exact cover checks unquotiented input n=3..6.

entries.name: additive coloring homomorphisms
entries.why: Fingerprint of the complete additive quotient, not a new obstruction.
checks: Smith factors 4,20; count each generator image independently.

entries.name: square-torus quotient order
entries.definition: Order of the cell module modulo all wrapped fe70 placements on (Z/n)^2.
entries.why: Shows exactly how parity of the torus period changes additive torsion.
checks: Laurent identities force x²=y²=1; odd n collapses both axes.
Direct n=1,2 period matrices have Smith orders 10,80.

entries.name: square-torus wrapped placement types
entries.definition: Number of distinct integer cell-multiplicity columns from eight aspects and n² anchors on (Z/n)^2.
entries.why: Measures aspect/translation collisions before any tiling search.
checks: Count multiplicities, not just occupied residue sets.
Each type is built from all ten literal cells.

entries.name: square-torus incidence rank mod 2
entries.definition: Rank over F2 of the n²-cell by wrapped-placement incidence matrix.
entries.why: Periodic binary coloring dimension is the complementary corank.
checks: Z/10 for odd n and Z/4⊕Z/20 for even n; reduce modulo 2.

entries.name: square-torus incidence rank mod 5
entries.definition: Rank over F5 of the n²-cell by wrapped-placement incidence matrix.
entries.why: Contrasts the constant mod-5 area coloring with binary parity resonance.
checks: Both Smith quotient types have exactly one 5-primary generator.

entries.name: contained-anchor incidence rank mod 2
entries.definition: F2-rank of cell by placement matrix: each of 8 aspects anchored in [0,n-1]²; cells in [0,n+5]².
entries.why: Characteristic-dependent signed-move supply in finite windows; not honest trades.
checks: Exact sparse prime-field elimination from literal placement cells.
At n=4 rank is 73 of 128 columns.

entries.name: contained-anchor incidence rank mod 3
entries.definition: F3-rank of cell by placement matrix: each of 8 aspects anchored in [0,n-1]²; cells in [0,n+5]².
entries.why: Characteristic-dependent signed-move supply in finite windows; not honest trades.
checks: Exact sparse prime-field elimination from literal placement cells.
At n=4 rank is 75 of 128 columns.

entries.name: contained-anchor incidence rank mod 5
entries.definition: F5-rank of cell by placement matrix: each of 8 aspects anchored in [0,n-1]²; cells in [0,n+5]².
entries.why: Characteristic-dependent signed-move supply in finite windows; not honest trades.
checks: Exact sparse prime-field elimination from literal placement cells.
At n=4 rank is 74 of 128 columns.

entries.name: contained-anchor binary kernel dimension
entries.definition: Dimension over F2 of the kernel of ALG06's 8n²-column incidence map.
entries.why: Quantifies binary signed relations, distinct from honest 0/1 trades.
checks: Rank-nullity from independently generated 8n² placements and ALG06.

entries.name: formal low quartic-phase aspect vectors
entries.definition: Number of v∈N⁸ with Σv=2n, u·v=0 mod4, even horizontal/vertical totals, c·v=n mod2 (as residue 0 or 1).
entries.why: Counts feasible-looking orientation totals under known charges, not placements.
checks: One generating-function factor per aspect; counts vectors, not ordered tile words.

entries.name: formal high quartic-phase aspect vectors
entries.definition: As ALG10, but c·v=(n mod2)+2 mod4.
entries.why: Exposes the small bias between two absolute phases surviving existing invariants.
checks: Same exact generating-function DP as ALG10.

entries.name: formal 10-by-even-height count vectors
entries.definition: Number of nonnegative aspect-count vectors of total H for a hypothetical 10×H rectangle, H=8+2n, satisfying c·v=κ(10,H), u·v=0 mod4 and even H/V aspect totals.
entries.why: Tracks the absolute R1 phase without claiming any 10-wide rectangle tiles.
checks: κ(2m,2h)=mh(m+h)-3[m,h odd] mod4; exact vector DP.

entries.name: chain-trade bounded holes
entries.definition: Number of bounded 4-connected holes in the 6n+2-copy honest trade region.
entries.why: Counts genuinely topological defects; all members have non-10-divisible holes.
source: R1 fe70_topology_research/chain_family.md and fe70_chain_trade.py in fe70_topology_research.zip
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.
Independent STR01 enumeration agrees for its complete 8-term prefix.

entries.name: chain-trade total hole area
entries.definition: Sum of bounded-hole cell areas in that trade region.
entries.why: Separates growth of defect area from growth of tile count.
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.

entries.name: chain-trade inner perimeter
entries.definition: Number of tile-region boundary unit edges incident to bounded holes.
entries.why: Tracks complexity of internal interfaces, not merely hole count.
source: R1 fe70_topology_research/chain_family.md and fe70_chain_trade.py in fe70_topology_research.zip
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.
Independent STR03 enumeration agrees for its complete 8-term prefix.

entries.name: chain-trade outer perimeter
entries.definition: Number of region boundary unit edges incident to the unbounded complement.
entries.why: Measures the outer boundary cost of lengthening the trade.
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.

entries.name: chain-trade tile-contact edges
entries.definition: Number of unordered pairs of distinct A-side tiles sharing at least one unit cell edge.
entries.why: The contact graph is a geometric statistic not fixed by area alone.
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.

entries.name: chain-trade overlap cycle rank
entries.definition: Cyclomatic number E−V+1 of the bipartite A/B cell-overlap graph after cancellation.
entries.why: Measures independent overlap loops relevant to trade decompositions.
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.

entries.name: chain-trade strong overlap pairs
entries.definition: Number of A/B tile pairs sharing at least two cells.
entries.why: Distinguishes broad retile overlaps from one-cell contacts.
checks: Reconstructed all 6n+2 source placements and reflected whole tiles.
Checked equal unions, disjointness, exact hole multiset and connectivity formula.

entries.name: Pfaffian-exception holes in the n-chain
entries.definition: Number of bounded holes with an odd black or odd white checkerboard population.
entries.why: Counts holes that prevent direct use of R1's mod-four matching invariant.
source: R1 fe70_topology_research/chain_family.md and fe70_chain_trade.py in fe70_topology_research.zip
checks: Rebuilt both disjoint n-chain tilings from causal D4 shapes and checked equal cells.
Flood-filled bounded complement; hole-area multiset matches R1 formula for n=1..8.

entries.name: D4 orbit size of the signed n-chain trade
entries.definition: Number of distinct D4 images of the signed trade modulo translation and swapping its two tilings.
entries.why: Avoids duplicate witnesses in honest-trade enumeration.
source: R1 fe70_topology_research/chain_family.md and fe70_chain_trade.py in fe70_topology_research.zip
checks: Rebuilt both disjoint n-chain tilings from causal D4 shapes and checked equal cells.
Flood-filled bounded complement; hole-area multiset matches R1 formula for n=1..8.
Enumerated eight cellwise D4 images at every n.

entries.name: Certified depth-12 collar x-increments
entries.definition: Increasing positive increments attainable by concatenating the named certified x-axis return loops of the 110x110 depth-12 collar, not all possible collars.
entries.why: Exact numerical-semigroup spectrum of a four-sided collar construction; all increments >= 280 occur.
checks: Generator periods are [50, 58, 60, 65, 67].
Independent residue-Dijkstra conductor is 280; source loops have cellwise replay certificates.

entries.name: Certified depth-12 collar y-increments
entries.definition: Increasing positive increments attainable by concatenating the named certified y-axis return loops of the 110x110 depth-12 collar, not all possible collars.
entries.why: Exact numerical-semigroup spectrum of a four-sided collar construction; all increments >= 142 occur.
checks: Generator periods are [45, 49, 50, 52, 58, 62, 67].
Independent residue-Dijkstra conductor is 142; source loops have cellwise replay certificates.

entries.name: Rooted connected 2x5-block region count
entries.definition: Number of distinct connected cell unions of k disjoint 2x5 blocks with one horizontal block fixed at origin; all other blocks may turn.
entries.why: Measures the exact geometry searched in the auxiliary honest-trade census, without treating it as a complete fe70-region count.
checks: Fixed-root growth exhausts connected block packings; corrected fe70 exact-cover anchor enumeration was rerun.

entries.name: Existence of an honest fe70 versus 2x5-block trade
entries.definition: 1 iff some finite region has two honest tilings, one by k fe70 copies and one by k 2x5 blocks; 0 otherwise.
entries.why: Tests a positivity-sensitive auxiliary-tile bridge; k=6 is the first unresolved even order.
checks: All odd k are impossible by fe70 C4 cell charge: each block has odd charge.
All connected block packings with k<=4 were enumerated and had no fe70 cover; disconnected trades reduce to components.

entries.name: Least arithmetically admissible width
entries.definition: Minimum positive w satisfying the complete old arithmetic for an h-by-w rectangle; no geometric claim.
entries.why: Gives the height-dependent congruence step for every rectangle search.
checks: LCM formula independently compared with direct admissibility and zero cell charge on all dimensions <=120.

entries.name: Least admissible long side
entries.definition: Minimum w >= h satisfying old arithmetic for h-by-w.
entries.why: The first arithmetic candidate at each short side.
checks: All widths are exactly the positive multiples of ARI01.

entries.name: Admissible shapes at even tile order
entries.definition: Number of unordered positive dimension pairs w <= h, wh=20n, satisfying old arithmetic (tile order 2n).
entries.why: Separates arithmetic scarcity from search failures at a given tile order.
checks: Exact divisors through integer square root; each factor pair counted once.

entries.name: Least admissible perimeter at even tile order
entries.definition: Minimum 2(w+h) over the dimension pairs counted in ARI03.
entries.why: Identifies the most compact admissible board at each order.
checks: Finite exhaustive factor-pair enumeration; the admissible pair (2,10n) guarantees existence.

entries.name: Admissible shapes with odd short side
entries.definition: Number of ARI03 factor pairs whose short side is odd.
entries.why: Measures how much an odd-short-side obstruction would remove.
checks: Same exhaustive divisors, independently checking that any odd side forces the other side divisible by8.

entries.name: Admissible shapes surviving hypothetical order-four rule
entries.definition: Number of ARI03 factor pairs with area divisible by40. The added restriction is hypothetical, not proved.
entries.why: Quantifies the proposed stronger arithmetic rule without assuming it is true.
checks: Direct condition 40 divides20n; no solver result is used.

entries.name: Admissible dimensions in a square size window
entries.definition: Number of unordered pairs 1 <= w <= h <= n satisfying old arithmetic.
entries.why: A clean baseline for the cumulative size of a rectangle campaign.
checks: Compared with the sum of floor(h/width_step(h)) for h<=n.

entries.name: Admissible near-square shapes at each short side
entries.definition: Number of widths h <= w <= 2h satisfying old arithmetic for h-by-w.
entries.why: Restricts the arithmetic baseline to aspect ratio at most2, rather than arbitrarily thin boards.
checks: Literal range enumeration with independent divisibility formula above.

entries.name: Arithmetic candidate orders above the known short-side exclusion
entries.definition: List wh/10 with multiplicity for old-admissible pairs 83 <= w <= h, sorted by (wh,w,h). This ignores further board-specific exclusions.
entries.why: An intrinsic comparison schedule after removing all heights <=82; not the current unfinished queue.
checks: Every pair of area<=16000 is enumerated, and the final displayed area is below that cutoff.

entries.name: Least arithmetic tile order with both sides at least n
entries.definition: Minimum wh/10 over all old-admissible w,h >= n.
entries.why: Turns a hypothetical short-side theorem into its best purely arithmetic order bound.
checks: A square of side40*ceil(n/40) is admissible; any larger short side has strictly larger area, so the finite scan is exhaustive.

entries.name: Order of the square's additive charge
entries.definition: Order of charge(n,n) in Z/4 x Z/20, i.e. the least positive k annihilating that cell-charge vector.
entries.why: A finite-group baseline for how square defects accumulate; not a geometric tiling order.
checks: Closed charge formula checked against literal cell sums at small sizes.

entries.name: Distinct rectangle charge classes
entries.definition: Number of distinct Z/4 x Z/20 charges of origin-anchored ordered rectangles with both dimensions in1..n.
entries.why: Shows saturation of the finite arithmetic information before geometry is considered.
checks: Explicit exact residue set; charge formula independently checked.
